title: Chinese UAP task force reported in South China Morning Post

tellings.quote: Do note in the South China Morning post, I want to say it was June 2021 and they had an article like, Oh yeah, we have a UAP task force too.
in fact China had a couple years ago in the China Morning Sun an article about the five continents initiative
tellings.difference: Calls the effort the 'five continents initiative' and the paper the 'China Morning Sun', with no date beyond 'a couple years ago'; Grusch's telling puts it in June 2021 and calls it a UAP task force.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a Chinese newspaper article from a few years back reporting a Chinese state UAP effort. 'China Morning Sun' looks like a garbled South China Morning Post.

plain: China has its own government team studying UAP, the official term for UFOs, and a newspaper said so openly. Two guests tell Michels this. The first is David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer, who says that around June 2021 the South China Morning Post ran an article that amounted to "Oh yeah, we have a UAP task force too." If he is right, the United States is not the only power quietly studying these objects. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, tells it differently on another episode. He says that "a couple years ago" a paper he calls the "China Morning Sun" wrote about a "five continents initiative". Neither man describes what the article found, and they disagree on the paper's name, the date and what the effort was called.
